items.title: Controlled Total East and Moses South diagnosis

queries.reportingPeriod: 2025; two fresh annual diagnostic runs, checked October 15, 2026 local time

source.label: Frozen previous and repaired models plus hydro-only and PV20-only annual runs

metricDefinitions.label: MAE
metricDefinitions.definition: Mean absolute error in public-scale MW on exactly the same 8651 qualified hours and unchanged primary diagnostic operators.

metricDefinitions.label: Factor effects
metricDefinitions.definition: Average each input change's marginal effect with and without the other change; the two effects sum to the total metric change.

filters: Identical 8651-hour cohort across B, G, P and GP; 8760 physical clock rows retained.
caveats: Effects are controlled effects within the model, not real-world source-error attribution.
Physical Total East/Central East/P32 mapping remains incomplete; partial PV20 readout sensitivities are not promoted.
Moses MAE interaction largely reflects offsetting signed changes and the absolute-error metric.

evidenceFlow.title: Independent checks
evidenceFlow.detail: Both new annual runs pass all8651hours; 24 baseline/combined bridges, 48 sample metadata checks, full-year KCL/branch/input/accounting checks and224 independent headline metric/effect calculations pass.

queries.reportingPeriod: 2025 annual plant energy and current model qualified subset

source.label: Final EIA-923, verified six-plant identity crosswalk and current compiled profiles

metricDefinitions.label: Conditional wind excess bound
metricDefinitions.definition: Modeled energy in8651qualifiedhours minus the full-year EIA energy; nonnegative generation in the109excludedhours cannot erase the excess.

caveats: The27.479MW bound requires the model's nonnegative excluded-hour wind bounds. EIA net generation can be negative; attributing actual hourly error remains conditional.
AM means monthly values reported annually, not the annual-only A category with estimated monthly allocation.
The90.187MW annual shape-control MAE holds saved terminal correction fixed; only12source-selected pairs receive fresh AC solves.
Current model, map and handoff remain unchanged.

evidenceFlow.title: Independent annual source mismatch
evidenceFlow.detail: The existing wind prior uses the same statewide capacity factor across sites. All six matched wind plants are NYIS/ZoneD resources. The qualified modeled subset alone exceeds their full-year reported energy by237723.25MWh.
